newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard sees non-cash charge on notes.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard sees non-cash charge on notes.

text.p: Vanguard Cellular Systems Inc on Thursday said it would begin recognizing losses in the third quarter in connection with its investment in InterAct Sytems Inc notes and warrants.

The company said the losses would take the form of non-cash charges. It said it would begin to recognize gains in connection with the InterAct investment when the notes become due and are paid, Vanguard said.
The company said it would apply the modified equity method of accounting to its $12 million investment in InterAct's 14 percent senior discount notes due 2003 and warrants.
Vanguard said it previously recognized its proportionate share of losses relating to InteAct to the extent of its investment in the company's common stock.
Vanguard is an independent operator of cellular telephone systems, active in 29 markets under the CellularOne brand name.
